name: relaylings
description: Local-first, delightful collaborative agent delegation with original orb helpers.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:pages: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --base=/relaylings/ && node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs
scripts.check:release: npm run check:a11y && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
